nodes.label: Button Link owns UNDERLINE in the canonical TextStyle
nodes.rationale: Primary/default/link and text keep distinct weights; link decoration must not be added by a post-style setter.
nodes.contextual_tracking_rule: Normal tracking inside Modal/Empty states is a composition exception, not a Button master update.

nodes.label: BENI Standby and NAVI Analysis: no TEXT/TEXTPATH consumer
nodes.rationale: The census has zero UI and editorial text; do not convert vector artwork, images or poses to text to fabricate style coverage.

nodes.label: Title Slot and Updated timestamp retain different roles
nodes.rationale: Hidden Hover timestamps still need metadata styles; common references or containers cannot turn a title into metadata.

nodes.label: Greeting/User name, Subtitle and Status preserve distinct styles
nodes.rationale: A shared text-property reference does not unify typography. Standby/Active hidden text, Slots, suggestions and nested Conversation keep their own contracts.

nodes.label: Extra actions Slot does not impose the nearby Label recipe
nodes.rationale: Default/Hover/Disabled labels remain compact; future Slot content must follow the inserted component contract rather than proximity.

nodes.label: Expanded true/false still audit title, metadata, plan and nested roles
nodes.rationale: Hidden regions and shared references remain separate consumers; do not propagate assignments between different functions.

nodes.label: Conversation distinguishes Preview, response, Composer and identity artwork
nodes.rationale: Preview titles, messages, agent labels, composer text and micro counts keep different roles. BENI/NAVI artwork is not text; contextual actions retain their own tracking.

nodes.label: Dropdown Item: scaled Checkbox labels are contextual recipes
nodes.rationale: recipeScale=1 compares materialized metrics and instanceScale describes composition; this adds no public Checkbox size.

nodes.label: Empty states: titles and nested Button tracking remain contextual
nodes.rationale: Default/Compact/Inline versus Main retain title roles; normal and underlined nested action identities do not revise the Button master.

nodes.label: File Upload separates underlined action, feedback and success formats
nodes.rationale: Action text uses the UNDERLINE derivative while error/success feedback uses the undecorated recipe; Success Formats has its own style and nested Button labels use compact bold.

nodes.label: Filter Chip: Large, Middle and Small each select a distinct label style
nodes.rationale: The exact30 variants map ten ranges to each size-specific style; selected and interaction states do not justify merging sizes.

nodes.label: Fuentes: path and separator are scoped micro typography
nodes.rationale: Path/separator, Type/Location and Source are different roles; numeric similarity does not make the micro path a general Caption.

nodes.label: Header explicitly replaces base §10 company/RFC typography
nodes.rationale: The base text gives different sizes. This amendment adopts current catalogue/census identities for company and RFC rather than claiming historical equality; an action-style name does not make company text an action.

nodes.label: Icon Button requires typography because hidden Dot counts are text
nodes.rationale: No action label does not imply NOT_APPLICABLE; preserve micro-count legibility exception and a separate accessible name.

nodes.label: Historical0.1.1 scaled link readiness: header
nodes.rationale: Logical recipe identity and matching metrics alone do not satisfy the historical explicit-link requirement; do not change scale/geometry to hide the block.

nodes.label: InputField · aceptación TYP-FAM-01..05

criteria.required_evidence: Reconciliar todos los nodos/rangos de esta familia, incluidos ocultos, muestras e instancias; justificar cualquier sustitución de ID con trazabilidad anterior→nuevo.
Leer el TextStyle ID de cada rango después de la última mutación y cotejar con la tabla y `styleMap`; comprobar receta canónica, unidades y codificación numérica documentada.
Preservar contenido, colores/bindings ajenos, geometría, API de propiedades, variantes, Slots e instancias; documentar cualquier cambio técnico necesario y comprobar sus consumidores.
Volver a leer componentes que comparten propiedades o dependencias, con pruebas de texto y cambio de variante cuando correspondan; no validar desde el resultado inmediato de un setter.
Separar QA documental, asignación Figma, preservación, web y publicación de skills. El PASS anterior de estilos/web no prueba este nuevo consumo Figma.

nodes.rationale: La presencia del catálogo, el mapping o el resultado inmediato de un setter no prueba consumo final; se exige cobertura, aislamiento, preservación y separación de destinos.

nodes.label: Catálogo tipográfico 0.1.1: receta, unidades, tokens y description única
nodes.rationale: Referenciar identidad lógica y única description evita mantener valores tipográficos editables paralelos.

nodes.label: InputField · selección exacta de consumidores y TextStyle IDs
nodes.mapping_is: Intención de aplicación, no readback de consumo
